name: Verify that on transition operations can be aborted
fullName: api.2-disruptive.test_transitions_on.tavern#Verify that on transition operations can be aborted

steps.name: Stage 0: Retrieve a compute node from HSM to be used in later stages
Stage 1: Power the target node off to prepare it for the test case
Stage 2: Poll until the force-off transition operation has completed
Stage 3: Retrieve the completed off transition data
Stage 4: Verify that the target node is powered off using power-status
Stage 5: Issue an on transition for the target node
Stage 6: Abort the previously issued on transition
Stage 7: Poll until the aborted on transition operation has been aborted
Stage 8: Retrieve the data for the aborted on transition
